name: out-of-band-approval-delivery
description: Any approval secret (pairing code, confirmation code, one-time token) is delivered OUT of the API surface: host console + a root-readable file. API callers may START approval flows; only host-console readers may APPROVE them.
principles: An approval code in an API response makes the approval self-issuable: START and APPROVE must never be reachable by the same credential-free caller.
Deliver secrets through a channel the caller cannot read: host console log + root-only file under the data dir.
The approval page asks the operator to TYPE what the host shows; it never echoes a secret from the URL.
URLs and QR payloads carry identifiers only (pairing ids), never codes.
heuristics: Before shipping any approve/confirm endpoint: grep the response builder for the secret - if it appears anywhere in any response, the flow is self-issuable.
Prefer keying approvals by pairing id with the code side-channel-delivered; ids are addresses, not credentials.
Session-token transports stay dual (Bearer header for middleware, body field for legacy handlers) until all clients send headers; then the header-only flip is one env var.

decision_rules.condition: designing or reviewing an approve/confirm/pairing flow
decision_rules.action: Verify the secret never appears in any API response, URL, or QR payload; deliver via host console + root-only file.

decision_rules.condition: a caller requests an approval action without presenting the host-delivered code
decision_rules.action: Refuse; starting a flow is not approving it.
